name: cross_integer_class
comment: cross preserves the integer class of integer operands with MATLAB R2025b's PER-OPERATION saturating integer arithmetic: each element product saturates to the int range BEFORE the subtraction (cross(int8([100 100 0]),int8([0 100 100]))=[127 -127 127], NOT -128). Branches: int8 [-3 6 -3]; int32 [0 0 1]; saturation [127 -127 127]; uint8 [0 6 0] (negatives clamp to 0); int+double [-3 6 -3] (each product is int-scalar*double, allowed); int16 [-300 600 -300]; Nx3 layout; double*double unchanged. Class via isa(). NOTE not fingerprinted (MATLAB ERRORS, numkit lenient->double): different int classes (int8 cross int16) and int+logical. bugs/linalg/cross-integer-class.md.
